title: Update on NCSS' Job Fit Assessment and Referral Framework
what_it_is: Update on NCSS' Job Fit Assessment and Referral Framework

sections.label: NCSS mental health employment support
sections.summary: NCSS established a referral framework with Workforce Singapore and the Employment and Employability Institute for jobseekers with mental health conditions, rolling out June 2026, and is developing a vocational assessment framework.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The National Council of Social Service (NCSS) has established a referral framework with the employment support agencies, the Workforce Singapore and the Employment and Employability Institute.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The referral framework helps to identify and provide customised employment support for jobseekers with mental health conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: It will be rolled out in June 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: NCSS is also developing a vocational assessment framework across the employment support agencies to assess the work readiness and support needed by persons with mental health conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: NCSS is in the process of standardising the assessment tools to be used and the type of professionals who will be conducting the assessment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: And is there a planned duration for which support will be provided for persons with mental health conditions and in recovery who are seeking jobs?

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: I think mental health conditions encompass a very wide spectrum, so the key thing is to make sure that in our support rendered, it will be individualised to the needs of the individual.

sections.label: Individualised support duration
sections.summary: The duration of support will be individualised because different individuals with different conditions have different needs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: As for the duration, again, it is going to be individualised, because different individuals with different conditions will have different needs as well.

sections.label: Unsuitable employment cases
sections.summary: Some individuals' conditions may be unsuitable for employment, so other measures to support their needs will have to be considered.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Clearly, there will be certain individuals where the condition will be quite unsuitable for employment and therefore, regardless of what the duration is, it may not reach a point where the person can reach capability to be deployed meaningfully in a workplace; in which case, other measures to support the individual's needs will have to be considered.
